Team leaders Kennesaw State Passing: Rickie Collins, 1,027 yards, 3 TDs, 3 INTs, 68.7 completion percentage Rushing: Collins, 246 yards on 55 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Brayden Munroe, 299 yards on 19 catches, 0 TDs Missouri State Passing: Skyler Locklear, 788 yards, 4 TDs, 2 INTs, 65.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jambres Dubar, 233 yards on 42 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Myers, 419 yards on 20 catches, 3 TDs Last game Kennesaw State fell 27-26 to Jacksonville State on Oct. 7.
